description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420201 and other Title Settlements
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in Mallawapitiya, which falls under the Land Gazette classification for land and property-related matters. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
